lines.en: So, I think, "Okay, this is my chance!" Let's give it a try!
lines.ja: これはいける！と思ったわけよ

lines.en: Because I'm known as Noodle Arms... And I had a pretty easy time against Cecilia.
lines.ja: 細腕に定評のあるこの私が…セシリアに腕相撲で圧勝したんだから！

notes.meaning: 細くて力のない腕を自虐的に言う表現

lines.en: I was surprised, I thought she would be stronger. So I was roasting her!
lines.ja: あの子、もっと強いと思ってたからさ めっちゃ煽ったった！

notes.meaning: からかう・けなす（からかい半分に言葉でいじる）

lines.en: And she was like... WTF! What the @#$%! No, don't roast me!
lines.ja: セシリアは…「やめて！」「煽らないで！」とか言って

lines.en: Everyone in the room was quite amused by what was happening, me and Cecilia. I was like, "OMG you're weak!"
lines.ja: 部屋にいたみんなも 私達の勝負を楽しそうに見てた「ざっこｗ」

lines.en: "I'm left-handed and you're losing against me!" "You're so weak!" "I'm known as Noodle Arms, and you're losing against me, OMG!"
lines.ja: 「私は左利きなのに右手で負けてやんの～」「はいキアラの細腕以下～ｗ」

lines.en: I was roasting the s**t out of her.
lines.ja: …って煽り散らかしたよ

lines.en: Giving mental damage and physical damage.
lines.ja: 体も心もボコボコにしたった

lines.en: And then I won with my right hand. Yo, pretty effortlessly...
lines.ja: 右手で勝っちゃったもん しかも余裕で…

lines.en: So, I was like... "Oh maybe I got stronger!"
lines.ja: だから「強くなったかも！」と思って

lines.en: And Kronii was sitting there, too, watching us... So, I was like, "OK, Kronii, let's do it!"
lines.ja: 座って見てたクロニーに挑んだの「クロニー、勝負だ！」

lines.en: But we start arm wrestling...
lines.ja: そして腕相撲開始

lines.en: And I'm still on the high of arm wrestling Cecilia and winning easily.
lines.ja: 私はセシリアに圧勝して絶賛イキり中で

notes.meaning: 〜の興奮・勢いに乗っている状態

lines.en: Right? I'm still like living on that high.
lines.ja: 勢いづいてるわけよ

lines.en: And then I'm going against Kronii and it's like not going so badly...
lines.ja: そのままクロニーに挑んだら、意外といい感じで

lines.en: I'm kinda keeping up, you know?
lines.ja: 私は食らいついてた

lines.en: And I'm like, "Oh WTF?" Like, "Eh? Did I get stronger? Wow!"
lines.ja: 「あれ…？」「私ホントに強くなってる？」

lines.en: "I'm actually not doing so badly!"
lines.ja: 「結構いい勝負じゃん！」

lines.en: I'm saying all this out loud... And I was just so excited.
lines.ja: これ全部声に出してた 興奮しちゃってさ

lines.en: And I looked at Kronii's face. And she's just like...
lines.ja: そこでクロニーの顔を見ると クロニーは…

lines.en: She just has the most serene, peaceful face.
lines.ja: この上なく穏やかな表情をしてた

lines.en: And I realize, "Oh..." Oh...
lines.ja: 私は気づいたの…

lines.en: You're not even trying.
lines.ja: 「こいつ…」「手加減してやがる…」ってね

lines.en: She's not even trying, she's playing with me, she's entertaining me!
lines.ja: 本気を出すどころか 私のために接戦を演出してた

lines.en: So sweet of her though. Because...
lines.ja: クロニーは優しい子だよ…

lines.en: The moment I say that I'm like, "Whatever."
lines.ja: 手加減に気づいた私が

lines.en: "You're messing with me!" Then we stopped. Um...
lines.ja: 「バカにしてんのか～！」って言って試合終了…
